items.title: Steve Turré interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 29, 2021
items.q: They took me to see Basie too, the band with Thad Jones and Snooky Young and our great Benny Powell and Frank Foster, Frank Wess, and you know, Freddie Green and all those cats.

ctx.x: Well this has been a fascinating conversation and I’m very pleased that your mother and father met at a Count Basie dance.

Yeah. They took me to see Basie too, the band with Thad Jones and Snooky Young and our great Benny Powell and Frank Foster, Frank Wess, and you know, Freddie Green and all those cats. It was great man.
Just to wrap up, is there anything that, on the bandstand or not on the bandstand, that makes you aggravated to the point of anger? And then I’ll flip that and what gives you great joy these days?
